title: Why Did Apple Stop Making White MacBooks? The MacBook Air Might Be The Culprit - BGR
summary: Apple launched the white MacBook in May 2006, the model that some longtime MacBook users may still remember fondly. That said, Apple's more recent MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, and MacBook Neo designs hint that Apple can partially satisfy the white MacBook dream.
